meeting_title: Meeting Report: Bayou Comfort Heating and Air After-Hours Intake Process

items.item: Daytime calls answered by dispatchers, job created in ServiceTitan
After hours calls roll to an answering service that takes messages
Messages emailed to a shared inbox, read next morning
Dispatcher calls each person back and enters job by hand
About 60 calls a day in summer
About 25 after hours calls a week (40 on hot weekends)
About 8 jobs lost a week
Average repair ticket about $400
Nine technicians, two on call rotation
About 15 arrival-time status calls a day in summer
RingCentral
ServiceTitan
Google Sheet
Podium
After hours callers wait until 10 to 10:30 the next morning (13 hours)
Answering service captures poor information (wrong/missing address)
Emergencies misjudged (woke tech for thermostat battery, missed no-heat newborn)
Unanswered callbacks tracked on sticky notes
Response within 15 minutes; measure time to first response and booked jobs
Owner Ray signs off; lead dispatcher Monique involved
Prospect sends ~10 anonymized answering service emails by Wednesday
Meeting Thursday at two with Ray and Monique
Axiom brings a one-page proposal for one lane
